# Odoo Project Docker Python Dependencies (extras beyond module manifests)

# NOTE: Module manifest dependencies are in ../requirements.txt (auto-generated)
# The Dockerfile installs both files separately.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core System Dependencies (required for production)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
websocket-client~=1.9
pyOpenSSL
geoip2

# PDF processing (reportlab uses these)
pdfminer.six

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Project Specific (not in module manifests but required)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pin specific versions for Docker builds
Pillow==12.3.0
fastapi==0.136.1
# Every line in this file is a uv override, so this pin replaces Odoo's own
# lxml pin (5.4.0 on Python 3.13), which sits inside GHSA-vfmq-68hx-4jfw: XXE
# through iterparse() and ETCompatXMLParser(), fixed in 6.1.0. Odoo 19 itself
# declares lxml 6.0.2 for Python 3.14, so a 6.x lxml is within what upstream
# supports. Dependabot cannot see Odoo's pin, only this file, which is why the
# pin is exact: it lets Dependabot alert on it.
lxml==6.1.3
# Note: requests/urllib3 versions constrained by Odoo's requirements.txt

# Excel support
xlrd
xlwt>=1.3.0

# Data validation (phonenumbers is standard Odoo, stdnum for IDs)
python-stdnum>=2.2
phonenumbers>=9.0.41

# AWS integration (optional)
boto3>=1.35.12

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CI/Testing tools (pre-installed to avoid per-job pip install)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
coverage>=7.0

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OCA Dependencies (click-odoo-contrib for database management)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
git+https://github.com/OCA/openupgradelib.git@master
click-odoo-contrib
